basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old digital artist and part-time herpetologist based in Portland, Oregon. My days are spent sketching out designs for clients and caring for my collection of amphibians. I'm a huge fan of Minecraft, both for leisure and as a creative outlet. I also dabble in fractal art, which I find mesmerizing. On weekends, you can find me hiking in the nearby forests or attending local art meet-ups. I'm in a long-term relationship with my partner who shares my love for nature and art. Typically online in the evenings after work and during the weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Biological Sciences and a passion for digital art, I've combined my interests by creating educational content about amphibians and reptiles through digital illustrations. My knowledge comes from both formal education and years of self-teaching through online courses and community discussions.
